queries_run: UNH UnitedHealth Group analyst consensus vs guidance 2026
UnitedHealth Group guidance raise OR cut 2026

findings.claim: 2026-10-13 公司發布 Q3 財報並上調全年指引：調整後 EPS 至少 $20.50（納入第三季經驗）
findings.excerpt: The company now expects full year 2026 adjusted net earnings of at least $20.50 per share, incorporating experience through the third quarter 2026.

findings.claim: 2026-07-16 Q2 後公司將全年調整後 EPS 指引上調至 $19.50–$20.00；當時彙整共識約 $18.43，指引高於共識；2026 年未見下調指引報導
findings.source: MarketBeat/聚合站 Q2 2026 報導；SEC 8-K Q2 2026

findings.claim: Q2 醫療成本率 86.7%，低於去年同期 89.4%，亦低於華爾街預期 88.47%
findings.excerpt: The second-quarter medical care ratio was 86.7% in second quarter 2026 compared to 89.4% in second quarter 2025.

findings.claim: 分析師目標價分布（聚合站，口徑不一）：Barchart 2026-07 均值 $482、最高 $529；Benzinga 約 24 位分析師共識 $443（20 買 4 持有，頁面更新 2026-08-31）；春季較低（Barchart 5 月均值 $389.16、最高 $444）。Q3 後（10/13 起）最新目標價分布未查到
2026-04 底 Zacks 類報告：FY2026 共識 EPS $18.12（30 日修正 +3.4%），Zacks Rank #3 持有；來源為鏡像站，可信度較低；Q3 後賣方預估修正未查到
findings.source: Zacks 風格報告（鏡像站）UNH Near-Term Performance Outlook
findings.excerpt: That said, the Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) designation signals that the recent positive momentum may be partially priced in at current levels.

capital_markets_pricing.note: Q3 後(10/13)共識 vs 指引落差與最新目標價 as-of 未取得；聚合站數字互相不一致，僅作範圍參考。
